title: Nahshon Wright: I'd love to stay in Chicago, had a great season because of how we played

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nahshon Wright: I'd love to stay in Chicago, had a great season because of how we played
sources.description: When cornerback Nahshon Wright was released by the Vikings in April, there weren't a lot of thoughts that he'd end the season in the Pro Bowl.
